title: ColorSpeak+
description: This plugin lets players insert codes like g/red or g/blue directly into their chat messages to color only specific parts of the text. It gives players full control to style their messages with custom colors.
body:
🎨 Farben:

| Code             | Farbe          |
| ---------------- | -------------- |
| `g/black`        | Schwarz        |
| `g/dark_blue`    | Dunkelblau     |
| `g/dark_green`   | Dunkelgrün     |
| `g/dark_aqua`    | Dunkeltürkis   |
| `g/dark_red`     | Dunkelrot      |
| `g/dark_purple`  | Dunkellila     |
| `g/gold`         | Gold           |
| `g/gray`         | Grau           |
| `g/dark_gray`    | Dunkelgrau     |
| `g/blue`         | Hellblau       |
| `g/green`        | Hellgrün       |
| `g/aqua`         | Cyan           |
| `g/red`          | Rot            |
| `g/light_purple` | Pink / Magenta |
| `g/yellow`       | Gelb           |
| `g/white`        | Weiß           |


✨ Effects:
| Code              | Effekt                             |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `g/bold`          | Fett                               |
| `g/italic`        | Kursiv                             |
| `g/underline`     | Unterstrichen                      |
| `g/strikethrough` | Durchgestrichen                    |
| `g/obfuscated`    | Magische, randomisierte Zeichen    |
| `g/reset`         | Setzt alle Farben & Effekte zurück |
